lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming discernible grid nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, elongated remora is attached to the upper lateral flank between the second and third visible vertical columns of spots.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, linear feature, likely the posterior section of a secondary remora, extends into the frame from the lower ventral edge.
